subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Neural Tube Defects and the PCPNDT Act

steps.tx: Failure of the neural tube to close in the first month forms **neural tube defects**. Anencephaly and spina bifida are the main types, varying from lethal to surgically correctable. Folic acid before conception prevents the majority. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Neural tube defects follow failed closure in the first month and folic acid prevents most.

vis.alt: Folic acid preventing neural tube defects.
vis.caption: Folate prevention. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Periconceptional folic acid supplementation is the proven preventive, termed **folate prophylaxis**. Four hundred micrograms daily suits most women, with higher doses after a previous affected pregnancy. Starting after the missed period is too late for this purpose. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Folate prophylaxis must start before conception because the tube closes in the first month.

steps.tx: Open spina bifida leaks alpha fetoprotein into fluid and blood, enabling **biochemical detection**. Raised maternal serum AFP triggers detailed ultrasound of the spine. The lemon and banana skull signs accompany open defects on scanning. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: Open spina bifida raises AFP and shows lemon and banana skull signs on scan.

steps.tx: The Indian law prohibiting sex determination and regulating ultrasound use is the **PCPNDT Act**. Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques legislation mandates registration, records and prohibits disclosure of fetal sex. Violations carry imprisonment and licence loss. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: The PCPNDT Act prohibits sex determination and strictly regulates prenatal ultrasound use.

steps.tx: Anencephaly, absence of the cranial vault, is uniformly lethal and termed a **lethal anomaly**. Early ultrasound diagnosis allows couples timely choices. Supportive counselling and birth planning respect family values throughout. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Anencephaly is a lethal anomaly diagnosed early by ultrasound for timely choices.

steps.tx: Recurrence after one affected pregnancy is about one in twenty, quoted as **recurrence risk**. High dose folate starts before the next conception. Detailed scanning at sixteen to eighteen weeks targets the spine and skull. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Recurrence risk after an affected pregnancy is about one in twenty, needing high dose folate.

vis.alt: Folate deficiency context for neural defects.
vis.caption: Folate context. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Valproate and other folate antagonists raise neural tube risk as **teratogenic exposures**. Women needing them require specialist preconception planning. Alternative medicines or high dose folate may reduce the risk. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Valproate raises neural tube risk and needs specialist preconception planning.

steps.tx: Closed spinal defects covered by skin do not raise AFP and are called **closed defects**. They escape serum screening and many escape routine scanning too. Most present later with orthopaedic or bladder problems. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Closed defects hide under skin, escape AFP screening, and present later.

steps.tx: Fetal surgery for selected open spina bifida improves outcomes in trial settings, an evolving field of **in utero repair**. It trades prematurity risk against reduced shunt need and better leg function. Only specialised centres offer it after strict selection. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: In utero repair improves selected spina bifida outcomes at specialised centres.
